cim: Gloucester Lyceum to host community event on artificial intelligence with Jon Keller
cim_eredeti: Gloucester Lyceum to host community event on artificial intelligence with Jon Keller
szoveg_eredeti:
Three leading experts on artificial intelligence will come to Gloucester for a panel discussion led by WBZ’s long-time political analyst Jon Keller on Saturday, Nov. 14, at 1 p.m.

The free community event, sponsored by Gloucester Lyceum, is titled “AI’s Promise and Peril: A Conversation.” It will explore how the rise of artificial intelligence is impacting the economy, jobs, privacy and human relationships.
